tasks.name: Set up project environment
tasks.description: Initialize the project with necessary tools, frameworks, and libraries.

tasks.name: Design application UI
tasks.description: Create wireframes and design the user interface for the note-taking application.

tasks.name: Implement Create Notes feature (frontend)
tasks.description: Develop the UI for creating new notes.

tasks.name: Implement Create Notes feature (backend)
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to save new notes to the database.

tasks.name: Set up database schema
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing notes.

tasks.name: Integrate Create Notes feature
tasks.description: Connect the frontend and backend for the Create Notes feature.

tasks.name: Implement Organize Notes feature (frontend)
tasks.description: Develop the UI for organizing notes into categories or folders.

tasks.name: Implement Organize Notes feature (backend)
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to organize notes into categories or folders.

tasks.name: Integrate Organize Notes feature
tasks.description: Connect the frontend and backend for the Organize Notes feature.

tasks.name: Implement Search Notes feature (frontend)
tasks.description: Develop the UI for searching notes.

tasks.name: Implement Search Notes feature (backend)
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to search notes in the database.

tasks.name: Integrate Search Notes feature
tasks.description: Connect the frontend and backend for the Search Notes feature.

tasks.name: Write unit tests
tasks.description: Write unit tests for all implemented features.

tasks.name: Perform integration testing
tasks.description: Test the integration of all features to ensure they work together.

tasks.name: Deploy application
tasks.description: Deploy the note-taking application to a production environment.

T1.implementation_approach: Set up version control, install necessary tools, and configure the development environment.
T1.notes: Ensure all team members have the same setup.

T2.implementation_approach: Create wireframes and mockups for the application UI using a design tool.
T2.notes: Focus on user experience and consistency.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop the frontend form and interface for creating notes using a framework like React.

T4.implementation_approach: Create an API endpoint to handle note creation and save data to the database.
T4.notes: Use a RESTful or GraphQL approach.

T5.implementation_approach: Design and implement the database schema to store notes and related metadata.
T5.notes: Optimize for scalability and future features.

T6.implementation_approach: Connect the frontend Create Notes form with the backend API.
T6.notes: Test the integration thoroughly for data consistency.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop the frontend interface for organizing notes, such as drag-and-drop or folder structures.
T7.notes: Ensure it is intuitive and user-friendly.

T8.implementation_approach: Implement backend logic to support organizing notes, such as updating categories or positions.

T9.implementation_approach: Integrate the frontend organizing feature with the backend API.
T9.notes: Test for seamless interaction and error handling.

T10.implementation_approach: Develop a search bar or filter interface for searching notes on the frontend.
T10.notes: Include features like autocomplete or filters for better usability.

T11.implementation_approach: Implement backend search functionality using optimized queries or indexing.
T11.notes: Ensure fast and accurate search results.

T12.implementation_approach: Connect the frontend search feature with the backend search API.
T12.notes: Test for performance and edge cases.

T13.implementation_approach: Write unit tests for individual components, functions, and API endpoints.

T14.implementation_approach: Perform integration testing to ensure all components work together as expected.

T15.implementation_approach: Deploy the application to a hosting platform and configure the production environment.
T15.notes: Ensure proper monitoring and error logging are in place.
